column1: # Same schema as expansion-practice.tsv. Each block of 42 scenarios belongs exclusively to one new mock.

Mobile ticket inspection|交通運輸|rail passengers|Inspectors will accept tickets displayed on a phone screen.|The railway is reducing the use of printed travel documents.|Download the ticket before entering the station.|The full ticket code must remain visible during inspection.|Station staff will help passengers who cannot display a valid code.|A phone without an accessible ticket may delay inspection.

Sample fabric approval|採購物流|interior designers|The supplier will send fabric samples before producing the curtains.|Screen colors may differ from the actual material.|Return the signed color approval with the chosen sample number.|Production will not begin on the basis of a telephone conversation alone.|The supplier will confirm the production date after receiving approval.|Written approval is needed before the curtains can be made.

Delayed installation access|房產營建|building managers|The equipment installation has been moved to the evening.|The delivery truck cannot enter the narrow street during market hours.|Arrange for a staff member to open the service entrance.|Installers will not have keys to the building.|The supervisor will call when the truck leaves the warehouse.|Someone must be available even after normal office hours.

Temporary display loan|文化休閒|gallery assistants|A neighboring gallery has offered display stands for the weekend exhibition.|The existing stands cannot safely support the larger sculptures.|Check each borrowed stand when it arrives.|All stands must be returned before the lender's next exhibition begins.|The curator will arrange a vehicle for the return journey.|The borrowed equipment is available for a limited period.

Unexpected conference demand|活動企劃|event planners|The conference will use an additional room for a live video link.|Registrations have exceeded the main hall's safe capacity.|Offer the additional-room option to people on the waiting list.|Attendees in that room will hear the talk but cannot ask questions directly.|The event team will test the video connection before opening the doors.|The extra room provides access with a participation limitation.

Late sample collection|健康安全|clinic reception staff|The courier will collect laboratory samples earlier than usual.|The laboratory is carrying out maintenance later in the day.|Have the sealed sample boxes ready before the new collection time.|Samples received after collection must be stored using the approved procedure.|The laboratory will resume normal collection times on the following working day.|The change affects collection timing rather than the clinic's opening hours.

Refill station supervision|餐飲零售|store assistants|A staff member will supervise the new detergent refill station.|Customers need help choosing containers that can safely hold the liquid.|Check that each container is clearly labeled before filling it.|Containers previously used for food must not be filled with detergent.|The supplier will provide additional measuring equipment next week.|Not every reusable container is suitable for this service.

Practice interview appointments|教育學習|job seekers|The career center is offering short practice interviews.|Several applicants requested feedback before meeting potential employers.|Send the job description when booking a session.|The center cannot promise an interview with the actual employer.|A counselor will provide comments on the participant's responses.|The service prepares applicants rather than arranges employment.

Split shipment decision|採購物流|procurement officers|The supplier can send the available parts before the remaining items are ready.|One component requires additional quality testing.|Confirm whether the urgent items should be shipped separately.|A second shipment will incur an additional transport charge.|The supplier will issue revised delivery documents after receiving instructions.|Faster access to some parts may increase the overall cost.

Audio equipment collection|活動企劃|seminar hosts|Rented microphones must be collected from the side reception desk.|The main desk is reserved for registering arriving delegates.|Bring the equipment reservation number.|A microphone cannot be released without a signed collection record.|A technician will demonstrate the controls before handing over the equipment.|Collection requires documentation as well as finding the correct desk.

Team demonstration rehearsal|行銷服務|sales representatives|The product demonstration will be rehearsed using an older test unit.|The final display model has not yet arrived from the factory.|Follow the revised sequence in the demonstration notes.|Do not promise features that have not been confirmed for the final model.|The product manager will verify the feature list before the public event.|A practice unit may not represent every feature of the final product.

Missing document page|財務商務|contract administrators|The legal team has paused its review of the agreement.|The submitted copy is missing the page containing the renewal conditions.|Request a complete copy from the other party.|Do not insert text from an earlier version of the contract.|The review will restart when the complete current document arrives.|An older document is not a reliable substitute for the missing page.

Garden access arrangement|環境設施|maintenance workers|The gardener will enter through the rear service gate.|The main courtyard will be occupied by a school visit.|Leave the rear path clear of stored equipment.|Children must not enter the area while powered tools are in use.|The facilities manager will check the area before allowing normal access.|The work area needs separation from the visiting group.

Broadcast schedule notice|文化休閒|radio listeners|The local history program will air later this evening.|A live sports event has lasted longer than expected.|Consult the updated schedule on the station website.|The program recording will not be available until the broadcast has finished.|The station will announce the new starting time after the match.|Listeners may need to wait before accessing the recording.

Harbor safety announcement|交通運輸|boat passengers|Passenger boarding will move to the sheltered pier.|Strong winds have made the exposed platform difficult to use.|Follow staff directions to the temporary boarding point.|The departure time remains subject to the captain's safety assessment.|Crew members will announce boarding only when conditions permit.|Changing the pier does not guarantee an immediate departure.

Building drill briefing|健康安全|office occupants|The next evacuation drill will include a blocked-route exercise.|The safety team wants staff to identify an alternative exit.|Check the evacuation map before the drill begins.|Do not use an elevator during the exercise.|Floor wardens will record the time needed to clear each area.|The drill tests flexibility rather than memorizing only one route.

Limited archive access|文化休閒|research visitors|Access to fragile documents will require an appointment with the archivist.|Some papers have become too delicate for unsupervised handling.|List the documents needed when requesting an appointment.|Pens and food are not permitted in the document room.|The archivist will prepare protective supports before the visit.|Advance notice helps staff protect the requested materials.

Product demonstration cancellation|行銷服務|store shoppers|The cooking demonstration has been canceled this afternoon.|The visiting chef is unable to reach the store because of a transport disruption.|Leave an email address if you would like the revised date.|The discount on cookware will still be available today.|The store will contact interested customers after confirming a replacement session.|The event cancellation does not cancel the sales offer.

Maintenance water interruption|房產營建|hotel guests|Water service on the upper floors will pause briefly after breakfast.|A valve must be replaced in the main supply line.|Fill any drinking-water containers before the interruption begins.|The ground-floor washrooms will remain available.|Reception will notify guests as soon as normal service returns.|Guests still have access to some facilities during the work.

Public speaking competition|教育學習|student speakers|Finalists will speak without projected slides.|The judges want to assess spoken explanations without visual support.|Submit the title of the speech before the final round.|Small note cards are allowed but full scripts cannot be read aloud.|The organizer will publish the speaking order after receiving all titles.|Some written support is permitted even though reading a script is not.

Market waste sorting|環境設施|food stall operators|Waste stations will have separate containers for food scraps and packaging.|Mixed waste from the previous market could not be processed efficiently.|Show temporary staff which container to use for each material.|Compostable-looking packaging must not enter the food-scrap container unless approved.|The market supervisor will check sorting during the day.|Appearance alone does not determine whether packaging is accepted.

Factory visitor briefing|製造品質|factory visitors|The tour will avoid the coating area this morning.|A new protective finish requires controlled conditions while it dries.|Keep the visitor badge visible throughout the tour.|No visitor may leave the marked route without an escort.|The guide will show a recorded explanation of the coating process instead.|Visitors will learn about a process they cannot observe directly today.

Sports center opening|健康安全|sports center members|The renovated exercise studio will reopen with reduced class sizes.|The center is testing the new ventilation system under normal use.|Reserve a class place in advance.|An unused reservation must be canceled so another member can attend.|The center will increase capacity if the trial meets its operating targets.|The initial attendance limit may change after evaluation.

Service contract clarification|財務商務|business clients|The maintenance plan includes inspections but not replacement materials.|Clients have asked why parts appear separately on recent invoices.|Review the materials estimate before authorizing repairs.|No chargeable replacement will be fitted without approval.|The service adviser will separate labor and material costs in future estimates.|An inspection benefit does not make every repair component free.

Training venue comparison|教育學習|training coordinators|The team must choose a venue with separate spaces for group exercises.|The course now includes activities that would disturb nearby lectures.|Compare room layouts as well as rental prices.|A single large room does not meet the requirement even if it has enough seats.|The coordinator will visit the shortlisted venues before booking.|Capacity alone is not sufficient for choosing the venue.

Exhibition invitation correction|活動企劃|invited guests|The exhibition invitation listed an incorrect entrance.|Renovation work has made the advertised doorway unavailable.|Use the garden entrance shown on the attached map.|Guests must still present the original invitation at arrival.|The gallery will place a staff member at the closed doorway to redirect visitors.|The invitation remains valid despite the entrance correction.

Internet service installation|科技維修|new subscribers|The installation technician will need access to the building's communications cabinet.|The connection cannot be completed entirely inside the customer's office.|Arrange cabinet access with the building manager.|The technician cannot force open a locked shared cabinet.|The provider will confirm the appointment after access arrangements are recorded.|Successful installation depends on cooperation beyond the subscriber's own office.

Workshop material substitutions|製造品質|craft students|The workshop will use a locally available wood instead of the advertised variety.|The original wood has been delayed at the port.|Read the revised material notes before the first session.|The replacement must be sanded using the instructor's specified method.|The instructor will demonstrate the differences at the start of class.|A substitute material can require a different working method.

Ticket exchange conditions|文化休閒|concert ticket holders|Tickets may be exchanged for another performance in the same series.|The organizer is offering flexibility after a change to the published schedule.|Request the exchange through the original booking account.|Any difference in ticket price must be paid before the new ticket is issued.|The booking office will cancel the old ticket when the exchange is complete.|An exchange does not always keep the total price unchanged.

Equipment cleaning roster|健康安全|gym instructors|Instructors must record cleaning after every equipment-based class.|A shared record will help the next instructor confirm that the room is ready.|Sign the cleaning sheet after completing the listed steps.|A signature cannot replace the actual cleaning procedure.|The duty manager will inspect a sample of rooms each day.|The record supports verification rather than replacing the task.

Library collection review|教育學習|library users|The library is reviewing books that have not been borrowed for several years.|Shelf space is needed for subjects with increasing demand.|Suggest titles that should be retained for local research.|A low borrowing count does not automatically mean a book will be removed.|Librarians will consider historical importance before making final decisions.|Usefulness can be assessed using more than borrowing frequency.

Apartment parcel room|房產營建|building residents|Parcels will be stored in a locked room behind reception.|The lobby has become crowded with unattended deliveries.|Collect parcels during the posted reception hours.|Delivery staff are not permitted to use residents' access cards.|The manager will review whether longer collection hours are needed.|Secure storage may limit when residents can collect a parcel.

Newspaper correction process|行銷服務|local advertisers|Corrections to advertisement proofs must be submitted through a single contact.|Conflicting instructions from several staff members caused errors in the last issue.|Nominate one person to approve the final proof.|Changes sent after approval may not reach the printed edition.|The production editor will send a final confirmation before printing.|A clear approval chain reduces the chance of contradictory instructions.

Lost property catalog|行銷服務|transport customers|Unclaimed items will be listed by general description on a public page.|Customers often do not know which station received their lost property.|Provide identifying details through the private claim form.|Valuable items will not be released based only on a matching general description.|Staff will arrange collection after verifying the claim.|A public description helps locate an item without proving ownership.

Supplier credit note|財務商務|accounts staff|The supplier will issue a credit note for damaged goods.|Returning the damaged items would cost more than their remaining value.|Keep photographs of the damage with the order record.|Do not deduct the amount before the credit note is received.|The supplier will confirm how the goods should be disposed of.|Documentation is still required even when a physical return is unnecessary.

Shared kitchen induction|房產營建|new tenants|Users of the shared commercial kitchen must attend an induction.|Equipment settings differ from those in ordinary domestic kitchens.|Book an induction before reserving cooking time.|Previous professional experience does not remove the induction requirement.|The manager will activate booking access after attendance is recorded.|Experience alone does not demonstrate familiarity with this facility.

Mobile exhibition cases|文化休閒|touring exhibition staff|Display cases must be secured before the transport vehicle moves.|The cases are fitted with wheels that can roll during sudden braking.|Check the wheel locks and the securing straps.|Straps must not press directly against the displayed objects.|The transport lead will inspect the load before departure.|Protecting the cases must not place pressure on the objects inside.

Language exchange matching|教育學習|conversation partners|Participants will be matched according to availability and learning goals.|Matching only by preferred language has led to incompatible meeting times.|Update the availability section of the registration form.|A match is not confirmed until both participants accept it.|The coordinator will offer a new match if either person declines.|An initial suggestion does not commit participants to a partnership.

Outdoor screening update|活動企劃|film screening guests|The screening will move indoors if sustained rain is forecast.|The projection equipment cannot operate safely in wet conditions.|Check the event page before traveling to the venue.|Indoor seating is limited to advance ticket holders.|The organizer will post the final venue decision on the event day.|Walk-in admission may disappear if the screening moves indoors.

Charity delivery route|社區服務|volunteer drivers|Deliveries to the eastern district will follow a revised route.|Roadworks have closed the bridge used by the previous route.|Download the updated route sheet before leaving the depot.|Do not rely on an older printed route sheet.|The coordinator will call drivers if further closures are reported.|Previously familiar directions may no longer be suitable.

Rental deposit refund|財務商務|equipment customers|Deposits will be returned after the equipment inspection is complete.|Some damage is not visible until the equipment is tested.|Provide the original payment reference when returning the items.|The deposit cannot be refunded to an unrelated payment account.|The rental office will send the inspection outcome by email.|Returning the equipment does not guarantee an immediate refund.

Volunteer reference letters|職場人事|former volunteers|The center can provide letters describing verified volunteer service.|Some volunteers need evidence of their responsibilities for applications.|Submit the dates and activities you want confirmed.|The center cannot certify activities that are absent from its records.|The coordinator will compare requests with attendance logs.|A requested statement must be supported by recorded evidence.
# Mock 03

Travel expense currency|財務商務|traveling employees|Foreign-currency expenses must show both the original amount and the approved conversion rate.|Different exchange-rate sources have produced inconsistent claims.|Attach the rate used on the payment date.|Estimated future exchange rates cannot be used for reimbursement.|Accounting will check the calculation before approving the claim.|Comparable records depend on a consistent conversion method.

Interview room privacy|職場人事|recruitment staff|Interviews will move to rooms with enclosed walls.|Conversations in the open meeting area could be overheard.|Update the room location in candidate invitations.|Candidate documents must not be left in shared waiting areas.|The recruitment coordinator will check room availability each morning.|The change is intended to protect confidential conversations.

Portable stage inspection|活動企劃|stage crew|The portable stage must be inspected after assembly.|Uneven ground can affect the stability of connected sections.|Report any gap between adjacent sections.|Performers may not use the stage before the inspection is signed off.|The venue technician will approve the completed structure.|A stage that looks complete may still be awaiting safety approval.

Donation matching deadline|社區服務|company employees|The company will match qualifying employee donations submitted this quarter.|The community fund has allocated a limited matching budget.|Upload the charity receipt through the staff portal.|Only charities listed in the published eligibility guide qualify.|The fund administrator will confirm the matched amount after review.|A donation to an unlisted organization may not receive matching funds.

Digital map correction|科技維修|delivery drivers|The route application will allow drivers to report incorrect access points.|Some map pins direct vehicles to entrances unsuitable for deliveries.|Include a description of the usable entrance in each report.|Drivers must stop safely before entering a correction.|The mapping team will verify reports before updating shared directions.|Reported changes are checked before other drivers receive them.

Reusable cup deposit|餐飲零售|cafe customers|Customers can borrow a reusable cup by paying a refundable deposit.|The cafe wants an option for customers who forget their own cup.|Return the cup to any participating branch.|The deposit is refunded only when the cup is returned intact.|Staff will inspect the cup and return the deposit at the counter.|Returning a damaged cup may not qualify for a full refund.

Lift reservation for movers|房產營建|moving contractors|Large deliveries must use a reserved service lift.|Unscheduled moves have interrupted access for other building users.|Book the lift through the facilities office.|Protective coverings must be fitted before loading furniture.|The building team will inspect the lift after each reserved period.|A reservation includes responsibilities for protecting shared equipment.

Conference captioning|活動企劃|presentation speakers|Live captions will be displayed during the main conference sessions.|Attendees requested better access to spoken presentations.|Send unusual technical terms to the captioning team in advance.|Speakers should avoid talking over one another during questions.|The captioning team will prepare a terminology list before the event.|Clear turn-taking can improve the accuracy of captions.

Book restoration estimate|文化休閒|archive managers|The conservator will assess selected damaged books before quoting for repairs.|Different bindings require different restoration methods.|Send photographs of the spine and affected pages.|Do not attempt adhesive repairs before the assessment.|The conservator will identify which items need an in-person inspection.|An initial photograph review may not be enough for every book.

Replacement access badges|科技維修|office staff|Lost access badges will be deactivated before replacements are issued.|An active lost badge could be used by an unauthorized person.|Report a missing badge as soon as it is noticed.|A badge found after deactivation must not be used again.|Security will issue a replacement after verifying the employee's identity.|Finding an old badge does not automatically restore its access.

Trial delivery service|行銷服務|retail customers|The shop is testing evening delivery within a limited service area.|Customers near the shop have requested later delivery times.|Check the address eligibility page before ordering.|Addresses outside the trial area must use the existing delivery options.|The shop will review trial results before expanding coverage.|The new service is not yet available to every customer.

School visit preparation|文化休閒|museum educators|School groups will receive an activity sheet before their visit.|Preparation helps students make better use of their time in the galleries.|Send the class age range when confirming the booking.|Activities must be adapted for groups with mixed reading abilities.|The education team will select suitable materials for each group.|The same worksheet may not suit every visiting class.

Public garden seed exchange|環境設施|local gardeners|A seed exchange will take place at the garden center.|Gardeners often have more seeds than they can use in a season.|Label packets with the plant name and collection year.|Seeds from plants treated with restricted chemicals are not accepted.|Volunteers will organize packets by plant type before the exchange opens.|Clear labeling helps participants judge what they are taking.

Office air-quality bulletin|健康安全|building staff|Air-quality checks will be carried out while the ventilation system is adjusted.|Recent measurements showed uneven airflow between floors.|Keep ventilation outlets free of boxes and furniture.|Do not change the control settings during the measurement period.|The engineer will recommend settings after comparing results.|Obstructed outlets can affect the usefulness of the measurements.

Town hall booking notice|活動企劃|community organizers|The town hall will accept provisional bookings before final event approval.|Organizers need a date to prepare funding applications.|State whether the booking is provisional on the request form.|A provisional booking does not permit public ticket sales.|The venue office will confirm the date once required approvals are complete.|Holding a date is different from having permission to run an event.

Health workshop announcement|健康安全|office workers|The lunchtime workshop will focus on practical ways to adjust desk equipment.|Staff have asked for guidance on uncomfortable working positions.|Bring a photograph of the usual desk setup.|The session provides general education rather than individual medical diagnosis.|The trainer will provide an equipment-adjustment checklist.|Participants can receive setup guidance without receiving a medical diagnosis.

Closed trail announcement|環境設施|park visitors|The upper trail is closed while fallen branches are removed.|High winds damaged several trees beside the route.|Use the lower marked path to reach the observation area.|Visitors must not pass the closure barrier even if no work is visible.|Park staff will reopen the trail after a safety inspection.|The absence of visible workers does not mean the trail is safe.

Office recycling demonstration|環境設施|new office tenants|A short demonstration will explain the building's recycling system.|Collection rules differ from those in nearby buildings.|Bring questions about materials you regularly discard.|Confidential documents must use the secure collection bins.|The facilities team will distribute a sorting guide after the session.|Some paper requires secure disposal instead of ordinary recycling.

Theater late-admission policy|文化休閒|audience members|Late arrivals will enter during designated breaks in the performance.|Moving through the seating area can disturb performers and other guests.|Wait with the usher until entry is permitted.|A valid ticket does not guarantee immediate entry after the performance begins.|Ushers will escort waiting guests to their seats at the next suitable pause.|Late guests may miss part of the performance despite holding tickets.

Library device charging|科技維修|library visitors|Charging lockers will be available near the information desk.|Visitors have requested a secure place to charge devices while reading.|Keep the locker claim ticket until collecting the device.|The library does not supply every type of charging cable.|Staff will help open a locker after checking ownership if a ticket is lost.|Some visitors will need to bring their own cable.

Public art consultation|社區服務|neighborhood residents|The council will collect comments on proposed public art locations.|The locations affect foot traffic as well as the appearance of the square.|Mark concerns on the displayed site plan.|Comments must concern the proposal rather than individual artists.|The planning team will summarize the feedback before making a recommendation.|The consultation considers practical effects in addition to appearance.

Supplier orientation talk|採購物流|new vendors|Vendors must learn the company's order-confirmation procedure.|Unconfirmed orders have caused uncertainty about delivery dates.|Acknowledge each order through the supplier portal.|An automatic email receipt is not treated as acceptance of the order.|The purchasing team will follow up on orders awaiting confirmation.|Receiving an order message is different from accepting the order.

Seasonal ferry service|交通運輸|island visitors|An additional ferry will operate on selected festival days.|Visitor numbers are expected to exceed the capacity of the regular sailings.|Book a place on the additional sailing separately.|Regular tickets do not automatically reserve a seat on the extra ferry.|The operator will release further places if a larger vessel becomes available.|Extra service has its own booking requirements.

Employee survey privacy|職場人事|survey participants|Survey results will be reported only for groups large enough to protect privacy.|Very small groups could make individual responses identifiable.|Avoid entering names in the free-text response area.|Managers will not receive individual response records.|The research team will combine small departments when reporting results.|Department-level reporting may be adjusted to preserve anonymity.

Software license transfer|科技維修|department managers|Unused software licenses may be reassigned to another employee.|Several departments are paying for licenses no longer in active use.|Ask the support team to approve the reassignment.|An account password must not be passed to the new user.|The support team will remove the old assignment before activating the new one.|License reassignment is not the same as sharing an account.

Stadium reusable containers|活動企劃|food vendors|Reusable containers will be collected in dedicated stations around the stadium.|The venue wants to reduce the volume of disposable food packaging.|Tell customers where containers can be returned.|Containers must not be mixed with general rubbish.|The cleaning contractor will count and wash collected containers.|A return system is necessary for the containers to be reused.

Warehouse lighting repair|製造品質|warehouse supervisors|One aisle will be closed while overhead lights are replaced.|Safe access equipment needs space below the fixtures.|Move urgent orders out of the aisle before work begins.|No picking work may take place beneath the maintenance platform.|The supervisor will reopen the aisle after the equipment is removed.|Retrieving urgent items in advance prevents conflicts with the repair work.

Hotel room accessibility request|房產營建|hotel reservations staff|Accessibility requests will be confirmed individually rather than inferred from a room label.|Guests may require different features even within the same room category.|Ask which specific features the guest needs.|Do not guarantee a feature until its availability has been checked.|The reservations team will send a written confirmation of the agreed features.|A general room category may not describe every feature a guest requires.

Reading competition entry|教育學習|competition entrants|Entries must include a short explanation of how the book influenced the reader.|The judges want personal reflection rather than a summary copied from a cover.|Describe one specific idea using your own words.|Previously published reviews cannot be submitted as new entries.|The judging panel will notify shortlisted writers after the deadline.|Original reflection is more relevant than repeating promotional text.

Street market power supply|餐飲零售|market stallholders|Electrical appliances must be listed before the market assigns power connections.|The available supply cannot support every high-power device at once.|Send the rating of each appliance you intend to use.|Unlisted appliances may not be connected on the day.|The electrician will allocate circuits after reviewing the combined requirements.|Electrical planning depends on total demand rather than stall size alone.

Design sample confidentiality|行銷服務|focus group participants|Prototype photographs must remain within the research session.|The designs have not been announced publicly.|Leave personal cameras and phones in the designated storage area.|Participation does not permit sharing images on social media.|The research team will release approved images after the public launch.|Taking part in research does not grant publication rights for the prototypes.

Water refill points|環境設施|festival visitors|Water refill points will be marked on the festival map.|The organizer wants visitors to stay hydrated without buying disposable bottles.|Bring a reusable drinking container.|Glass containers are not allowed in the performance areas.|Stewards will direct visitors to the nearest refill point.|A reusable bottle must still satisfy the venue's material restriction.

Recording studio booking|文化休閒|independent musicians|Studio reservations will include a short setup period before recording begins.|Projects need time to connect and test their equipment.|Send the equipment list when confirming the booking.|Setup time is included in the reserved period rather than added afterward.|The studio engineer will prepare compatible connections in advance.|Recording time may be shorter than the total reserved period.

Temporary retail entrance|行銷服務|shop visitors|Customers will enter through the adjoining arcade during facade repairs.|Protective scaffolding blocks the normal front doorway.|Follow the store signs inside the arcade.|The rear loading door remains closed to customers.|Staff will update the directions if the work area changes.|Not every alternate doorway is available for customer entry.

Grant spending records|財務商務|community grant recipients|Recipients must retain receipts for purchases funded by the grant.|The fund must verify that money was used for approved purposes.|Keep grant-related expenses separate from unrelated purchases.|A bank withdrawal alone is not sufficient evidence of the purchase.|The fund officer will request a spending summary at the end of the project.|Proof of moving money does not by itself prove an eligible expense.

Shared laboratory freezer|製造品質|research staff|Freezer boxes must carry both a project code and a responsible person's name.|Unidentified samples have occupied storage space for too long.|Review the labels on existing boxes.|Unlabeled samples must not be discarded without the required review.|The laboratory manager will contact project leaders about unidentified material.|Missing labels trigger investigation rather than immediate disposal.

Community transport requests|社區服務|volunteer transport users|Journey requests must include the passenger's return arrangements.|Drivers need to plan their available time for the full trip.|State whether a return journey is required when booking.|A one-way booking does not guarantee that the same driver can return later.|The coordinator will confirm each leg of the journey separately.|The outward and return trips may need different arrangements.

Photography permit process|文化休閒|commercial photographers|Commercial photography in the gardens requires a permit.|Large shoots can interfere with ordinary visitor access.|Submit the proposed locations and equipment list.|A permit does not allow the closure of public paths unless specifically approved.|The garden office will identify any conditions attached to the permit.|Permission to photograph does not automatically grant exclusive use of the site.

Conference poster revisions|教育學習|research presenters|Updated posters may be uploaded until the print deadline.|The printing contractor needs a stable file before production begins.|Check the final file size and orientation before upload.|Files submitted after the deadline will not replace the printed version.|The organizer will send a proof for confirmation before printing.|An online revision may be too late to affect the physical poster.

Shipping insurance valuation|採購物流|dispatch staff|Insured shipments must use the documented replacement value of the goods.|Unsupported estimates can cause disputes if a claim is made.|Attach the valuation record to the shipping request.|Do not include the value of unrelated items in the same claim.|The logistics office will check the declared value before dispatch.|A declared amount needs supporting evidence.

Resident notice translations|房產營建|housing staff|Important building notices will be available in the languages most used by residents.|Some residents have missed essential maintenance information.|Use the approved translated notice when one is available.|Do not rely solely on informal translation of safety instructions.|The housing office will update all language versions when the notice changes.|Translated notices must remain consistent with the current original.

Flexible art class materials|教育學習|evening art students|Students may bring their own materials instead of buying the class pack.|Experienced students often already own suitable supplies.|Compare personal materials with the required list.|Materials must meet the stated safety requirements.|The instructor will check unfamiliar products before they are used.|Owning materials does not guarantee that every product is suitable for the class.
# Mock 04

Appointment reminder preference|健康安全|clinic patients|Patients can choose either a text reminder or an email reminder.|Sending both formats has caused confusion for some patients.|Confirm the preferred contact method at the next visit.|Changing reminder preferences does not change the appointment itself.|Reception will update the preference after checking the contact details.|A communication preference is separate from the booking details.

Product repair tracking|科技維修|service customers|Customers will receive a tracking number when a device is accepted for repair.|The service desk wants customers to check progress without repeatedly calling.|Keep the tracking number with the collection receipt.|A status marked under assessment does not mean the repair has been approved.|The technician will send an estimate before chargeable work begins.|Tracking a device does not replace approval of repair costs.

Borrowed display plants|活動企劃|exhibition staff|Live plants will be rented for the exhibition entrance.|The organizer wants an attractive display without purchasing plants for one event.|Keep the plant labels attached throughout the rental.|Plants must not be moved into direct sunlight without the supplier's advice.|The supplier will collect and inspect the plants after the event.|The display items remain the supplier's property.

Factory shift handover|製造品質|shift supervisors|A written handover record will accompany each shift change.|Important equipment observations have been lost during rushed verbal exchanges.|Record unresolved faults before leaving the work area.|A written note does not replace an urgent safety warning.|The incoming supervisor will confirm which issues require immediate attention.|Routine documentation and urgent communication serve different needs.

Accessible voting meeting|社區服務|association members|The annual meeting will offer both seated and remote participation.|Some members cannot reach the upstairs meeting room.|State the required attendance format on the registration form.|Only registered members may vote through either format.|The secretary will send remote access instructions before the meeting.|Remote attendance does not broaden voting rights to nonmembers.

Reusable delivery labels|採購物流|packing staff|Returnable delivery boxes will use removable labels.|Permanent labels have made it difficult to identify the current destination.|Remove outdated labels before applying the new shipping details.|Do not cover a damaged barcode with a second barcode.|The dispatch supervisor will scan each box before loading.|Clear current labeling helps prevent routing errors.

Workshop interpretation request|教育學習|training attendees|Interpretation can be arranged for selected training sessions.|Participants have asked for support with technical explanations.|Submit the language request when registering.|Late requests depend on interpreter availability.|The training office will confirm supported sessions individually.|Requesting a language does not guarantee that every session can support it.

Public mural maintenance|文化休閒|building caretakers|The mural surface will be cleaned using a method approved by the artist.|Ordinary cleaning chemicals could damage the paint.|Report marks before attempting to remove them.|Do not apply a protective coating without written approval.|A specialist will inspect the surface after cleaning.|Protective treatment can still require expert approval.
